defect: The Q1 bucket precedence in the registered rule tested `vid not in replan_ids` BEFORE testing whether the owning vehicle is in a non-idle/ready status. Because a `committed` (in-transit) vehicle is never in `replan_ids`, its whole persisted suffix was filed as EXCLUDED_FROM_REPLAN instead of being attributed to the commitment contract.
how_it_was_found: The first run reported EXCLUDED_FROM_REPLAN=42 (SAA) with STATUS_NOT_IDLE_READY=0 and PROTECTED=0, i.e. an exclusion reason with no vehicle-status explanation. A read-only cross-tab of |replan_ids| against vehicle statuses then showed only three regimes, with the 42 excluded exposures co-occurring exactly with the 44 anchor exposures.

measured_regimes.reading: There is no idle/ready vehicle that is wrongly excluded. Every locked exposure belongs to the single `committed` vehicle of that phase: its committed_next order (the anchor) plus the not-yet-executed remainder of its persisted suffix.

corrected_bucket_rule: MUTABLE                       : order sits in the suffix of a vehicle in ref.mutable_ids(view)
ON_COMMITTED_VEHICLE_ANCHOR    : order equals a `committed` vehicle's committed_next
ON_COMMITTED_VEHICLE_QUEUE     : order sits in a `committed` vehicle's mutable_suffix
ON_CLOSED_VEHICLE              : order sits in a closed vehicle's suffix (expected 0)
ON_PROTECTED_VEHICLE           : owning vehicle is in view.protected (expected 0)
ON_EXCLUDED_IDLE_VEHICLE       : owning vehicle is idle/ready but not in replan_ids, or not idle/ready and not committed (expected 0; kept as a residual check)
UNREPRESENTED                  : accepted, unserved, and on no vehicle suffix and no anchor

expected_by_corrected_rule.why: the three diagnostic buckets must be empty if the whole lock is the commitment contract; a non-zero value would falsify the amendment

unchanged: Q2 mask-granularity census rules and policies
impact_on_conclusions: Q1 headline changes from 'a policy selection excludes persisted suffixes' to 'the lock is entirely the single in-transit committed vehicle'. The superseded first-run numbers are preserved under superseded_v1/ and MUST NOT be cited.
